summary: Master business etiquette, protocol and professional presence with practical tools, guest handling, and meeting standards. Enrol to apply it fast.
lede: Business etiquette training helps professionals handling formal interactions manage introductions, meetings, correspondence, and guest reception. Participants practice professional greetings and forms of address, apply etiquette to email and video calls, and learn business dining and VIP or event protocol through practical workplace scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage formal interactions, workplace representation, and reputation-sensitive communication in everyday business settings.
modules: Foundations of Business Etiquette and Protocol
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to common workplace email and calendar tools, and examples of real communication or meeting scenarios where etiquette matters. The course works best when you are ready to apply the exercises to your current role.
